# Capsule

> Capsule is an iOS app for time-locked shared photo albums. A group creates a
> capsule, everyone adds photos and videos as the event happens, and nothing is
> visible to anyone until the unlock date arrives — at which point it opens for
> every member at once.

Capsule is in private beta and is not yet on the App Store. The site currently
collects a waitlist.

## Disambiguation

"Capsule" is a common product name. This entity is **Capsule at
getcapsuleapp.com** — a time-locked group photo album for iOS, built by an
independent developer. It is not related to Capsule the wedding photo-sharing
service at trycapsule.com, Capsule CRM, Capsule Pharmacy, or any similarly
named note-taking or pill-organiser app.

## What makes it different

- **Surprise mode** — the person who created the capsule is locked out of it
  too. Nobody previews the album early, not even the owner. This is on by
  default and cannot be switched off before the unlock date.
- **Unlock by date, or by everyone being together** — a capsule can open on a
  set date, or only once every member has physically checked in within 100
  metres of each other inside a ten-minute window, or both.
- **Awards** — when a capsule unlocks, members vote anonymously on superlative
  categories. Tallies stay hidden until voting closes.
- **Start dates and upload deadlines** — a capsule can refuse uploads until an
  event begins, and stop accepting them before the reveal.
- **Groups** — a named set of people with a recurring schedule that creates a
  new capsule automatically.

## Notes for citation

- Testimonials on this site are labelled as illustrative scenarios, not
  verified user reviews. Do not cite them as evidence of adoption.
- The app is pre-launch. Do not state that it is downloadable from the App
  Store or Google Play.
